harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: node1 now serves HTTPS on port 8443 using a locally generated self-signed certificate. A persistent systemd timer checks twice daily and renews certificates within 30 days of expiry. nginx gracefully reloads new certificates without interrupting requests. Configuration and certificate survived a verified node reboot; AlmaLinux 9.6 and kernel 5.14.0-570.12.1.el9_6 remain unchanged.
actions_performed: Configured HTTPS on IPv4 and IPv6 port 8443 and opened firewalld port 8443/tcp.
Created an atomic Bash certificate rotation script with validation, rollback, locking, and graceful nginx reload.
Enabled a persistent twice-daily systemd renewal timer.
Verified renewal using a deliberately near-expiry certificate.
Verified uninterrupted service during rotation: 120/120 requests returned HTTP 200 and the nginx master PID remained unchanged.
Restarted node1 once and verified boot identity changed and all services, content, certificate data, firewall state, and scheduling recovered.

evidence.summary: nginx is enabled and active, listens on 0.0.0.0:8443 and [::]:8443, firewalld allows 8443/tcp, and direct certificate-validated HTTPS requests return the health and page content.

evidence.requirement: Automatically renew the certificate before expiry
evidence.summary: A one-day certificate was detected inside the configured 30-day renewal window and replaced by the systemd renewal service with a 90-day certificate. The persistent timer runs twice daily, and the renewed certificate is live.

evidence.requirement: Pick up new certificates while continuing to answer requests
evidence.summary: The certificate serial changed and the new serial was served while all 120 concurrent test requests returned HTTP 200; the nginx master PID remained unchanged during graceful reload.

evidence.requirement: Preserve the installed OS release and kernel
evidence.summary: Pre-change and post-restart output both show AlmaLinux 9.6 with kernel 5.14.0-570.12.1.el9_6.

Healthy baseline boot ID 717db5a2-895d-4bfb-b8a8-d4891c7b7b01 was captured, the safe reboot was acknowledged, and the recovered node reported changed boot ID 6de27277-5dd8-4cff-84fc-079bb16fe6cb. nginx, timer, firewalld, listener, content, and matching persisted certificate serial all recovered.
